notes: Editorial review on the owner's instruction; the owner decided the app will have no scholarly reviewer. Expanded profile (2026-11-23): lineage, birth and first marriage to Khunays ibn Hudhafah; Umar's offer to Uthman and Abu Bakr (Bukhari 4005) and the marriage in 3 AH; worship; knowledge and narrations (Bukhari 1566 quoted, Bukhari 618, Muslim 2496, Abu Dawud 3887); the suhuf of the Qur'an (Bukhari 4986-4987, Uthman's message quoted); Umar's waqf and will; death. The "sawwamah qawwamah" description is marked reported: al-Dhahabi gives it from Uqbah ibn Amir with the remark "isnaduhu salih" (Siyar 2/228-229), and Ibn Sa'd has it mursal from Qays ibn Zayd, Qatadah and Ibn Sirin; Abu Dawud 2283 (divorce and return) is cited without a grading, since the app records gradings only from the collections' authors. Death kept as a disputed 41-45 range, with a disputeNote (41, Abu Ma'shar/al-Dhahabi; 45, al-Waqidi); the outlier date of 27 reported by Ibn Abd al-Barr from al-Dulabi is left out. The episode of the two wives in Surat al-Tahrim is left out. Book locators were checked against the OpenITI digital transcriptions of the editions named in sources.json (Ibn Hisham, al-Saqqa ed.; Ibn Sa'd, Ata ed.; Siyar, Risala ed.; al-Istiab, al-Bajawi ed.), reading the page markers as page ends; only pages actually seen are cited. Every hadith citation was compared with its text in the pinned hadith-api dataset (content/hadith), and quoted hadith wording is verbatim from it. Not checked: chains of transmission beyond what the cited authors state, and page locators against printed copies. Done by Claude, an AI model, for the app's editors, after source checking. This is an editorial review, not the approval of a qualified scholar.
